labelling.note: Labels are computed from criterion states by the same function the system uses. They are NOT expert clinical judgements.

partition_rule.method: rank of sha256(case_id)[:8] within (policy_version x category) stratum

scoring_budget.note: Additional scorings must be declared in an ADR in advance. Re-scoring a frozen split until a number improves is how an evaluation becomes fiction.

spent_by.note: One scoring of a subset of the gold split. Recorded because a budget nobody decrements is decorative. Any further scoring must be declared in an ADR in advance.
